name: Céilí Dancers Aoife and Liam

intro.text: Take your partners for the Siege of Ennis! Two on two, advance and retire, and mind your feet!

win: Bualadh bos! A round of applause! You never missed a step.
after: The Siege of Ennis goes on until every line has danced with every other line. Which on a busy night is a very long siege.
